decisions.reason: The black-finish range rides the ongoing trend toward coloured bathroom fittings and was promoted to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment to a line that costs little beyond its finish variants.
The shower channel for seamless coverings has had its own page in both years, fits the firm's focus on barrier-free bathroom architecture, and sits close to its core CeraFrame line.

The pump-drain shower channel was launched only in 2024 and has its own page; it addresses renovation cases where gravity drainage is not possible, so it needs time on the market even though the earlier pump solution was withdrawn.
